name: s09-pyramid
title: The test pyramid for infrastructure code
spec: A pyramid of three layers. Wide bottom layer green: Unit tests (many, fast, no network). Middle layer: Integration tests (fewer, real dependencies). Small top layer orange: End-to-end tests (few, slow). An arrow on the left labelled cost and time rising upward.
cap: Test strategy: many fast unit tests, fewer integration tests, and very few end-to-end tests.

name: s09-di
title: Inject the dependency instead of patching
spec: Two panels. Left panel Production: function receives the real client and calls the real API. Right panel Test: the same function receives a fake client that returns canned data (green). Under them: the function takes the client as an argument. Grey crossed-out note: patching internals couples tests to the implementation.
cap: Dependency injection: pass a fake client in tests instead of patching module internals.

name: s09-hypothesis
title: Hypothesis finds and shrinks failures
spec: A flow of four boxes: you state a property (for all inputs, the result is valid) ; Hypothesis generates many inputs ; one input fails (orange) ; Hypothesis shrinks it to the smallest failing example (green). Under it: example-based tests check the cases you thought of, properties check the ones you did not.
cap: Hypothesis generates many inputs, finds a failure, and shrinks it to a minimal example.
